question: According to the 2011 census of India, which of the following states has a total literacy rate of 91.3 percent?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mizoram**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Mizoram,
 
 
• The literacy rate of 91.3%, was notable for its high literacy compared to many other states in India, especially those in the northeastern region.
 
 
 
• Mizoram's literacy rate reflects its strong educational infrastructure and a high focus on education, contributing to its status as one of the most literate states in India.
 
 
• **Male literacy rate:** 92.58%
 
• **Female literacy rate:** 90.18%
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Kerala
 
 
• It had the highest literacy rate in India at 93.9% in the 2011 Census. It is well known for its strong educational infrastructure and focus on literacy.
 
 
 
• Manipur
 
 
• It had a relatively lower literacy rate of 76.9%, indicating room for improvement in educational outreach and infrastructure.​
 
 
 
• Sikkim
 
 
• It had a literacy rate of 87.3%, which was lower than Mizoram's.
